messages:
incident-bot: PAGER → @oncall-liz: P0: Multiple streaming WS connections failing for tenant CatalystBank on VPC Gateway (region-us-east-2). Error rate spike at 08:23 UTC. Please ack and triage. :rotating_light:

oncall-liz: acked. jumping in. seeing lots of 1006 close codes and 'write ECONNRESET' from the appgw logs.

eng-platform-sam: pulling logs now. catalyst's gateway is hitting our per-tenant inflight limit and then clients see retries that escalate to websocket reconnect storms.

infra-ryan: verified pod restarts around 08:22 on the dedicated pool that serves CatalystBank - but pods are stable now. stack trace shows: ```
ws: close 1006 - write EPIPE
net: socket hang up
CacheKV: missing entry for prefix id=cb-tenant-42
```

oncall-liz: is this traffic surge from Catalyst or internal retry loop?

catalyst-infra-team: (via webhook) we deployed a change at 08:18 that tightened client retry backoff in their edge proxy, but we didn't expect this to increase connection churn. sending client-side logs.

customer-success-maya: catalyst reports a spike in failed streaming sessions and some customers seeing partial transcripts. high business impact. need ETA for fix.

eng-platform-sam: quick ask — can we temporarily route CatalystBank traffic to a compatible fallback model variant on a different pool to stop retries hammering the same VPC gateway?

infra-ryan: we have spare capacity in the 'dedicated-burst-3' pool in us-east-2. I can add a routing rule. downside: different model variant (quantized) — small quality delta.

oncall-liz: do it. add rule: route tenant cb-42 -> dedicated-burst-3 with sticky session ttl 15m. also enable websocket keepalive to 30s on the gateway.

eng-platform-sam: applying routing override now: ```PATCH /routing/policy/tenants/cb-42```
```json
{"route": "dedicated-burst-3", "sticky_ttl": 900}
```

infra-ryan: routing applied. initiating ws-keepalive update.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Routing change rolled to 3/3 hosts. ws keepalive config pushed to gateway fleet.

oncall-liz: monitoring. Catalyst retry rate down from 42% to 8% in the last 4 minutes. 1006 closes dropping.

catalyst-infra-team: confirming - client reconnections reduced. some sessions that were partial are still failing. any way to rehydrate those sessions?

eng-platform-sam: we can try a one-off replay for partial transcripts using the request logs and prefix cache if available. need approval from product/comms.

customer-success-maya: Catalyst legal wants an RCA and they want to know if we can restore lost transcripts. I'll co-ordinate.

oncall-liz: root cause hypothesis so far: client proxy change increased short-lived connection churn, which hit our per-tenant inflight cap and triggered aggressive client retries -> retry storm -> gateway queue saturation -> websocket connection resets (1006). Mitigations: routing to alternate pool + keepalive + temporary softening of inflight cap for cb-42.

infra-ryan: I've softened inflight cap from 200 -> 400 for tenant cb-42 for next 30 minutes to drain the backlog. watch for cross-tenant impact (should be isolated).

eng-platform-sam: also toggled prefix/KV cache warmup for cb-42 to keep KV hits higher.

incident-bot: paging oncall-handoff: @oncall-omar will take ownership in 25 minutes for postmortem and follow-up with Catalyst.

oncall-liz: handoff notes: routing override in place, keepalive increased, inflight cap temporarily raised, monitoring shows error rate stabilized. next: coordinate transcript replay options with Catalyst and schedule RCA.

oncall-omar: ack. I'll pick up the RCA and coordinate with eng/reliability. can someone grab a snapshot of the gateway logs and the routing policy diff?

eng-platform-sam: attaching diffs and a short grep of errors (pasted): ```
--- routing.orig
+++ routing.cb42
+ route cb-42 -> dedicated-burst-3

grep "close 1006" | head -n 20
[08:21:44] conn 11243 tenant=cb-42 close 1006 write EPIPE
[08:21:45] conn 11249 tenant=cb-42 close 1006 write EPIPE
[08:22:01] conn 11302 tenant=cb-42 close 1006 ws ping timeout
```

customer-success-maya: Catalyst wants a temporary SLA credit and details on preserved data. I'll escalate after the RCA draft.

catalyst-infra-team: are you able to confirm whether any PII-bearing transcripts were lost? we log partial buffers but not necessarily flushed to persistent storage on abrupt close.

eng-platform-sam: partials: some sessions never hit the final persist path. we have raw socket buffers and request ids; can attempt a best-effort reconstruction but will require CB's consent.

oncall-omar: plan for post-handoff: 1) collect full logs/metrics, 2) run transcript reconstruction attempt for identified request ids, 3) produce RCA and mitigation plan (avoid per-tenant retry storms), 4) propose config change: dynamic inflight scaling + burst tokens for VPC tenants.

incident-bot: NOTE: follow_up: Pager duty escalation scheduled + SRE review in 2 hours.

oncall-liz: closing active page - moving to monitoring-only. will leave notes in the incident ticket. thanks team. :heart: 

oncall-omar: taking over. creating incident ticket INC-2026-642 and assigning to eng-platform-sam + infra-ryan for RCA.

customer-success-maya: thanks — briefing cnx scheduled with Catalyst in 90 minutes. I'll share reconstruction ask.

catalyst-infra-team: thanks, appreciate the quick routing patch. we saw immediate improvement.

oncall-omar: summary for RCA: trigger = client-side retry change + short-lived connection churn; amplification = per-tenant inflight cap + sticky routing to saturated hosts; mitigation = route to alternate pool, increase keepalive, transient inflight raise, enable KV warmup. Need to decide permanent fix: auto-scale per-tenant inflight tokens and better backpressure signals to clients.

eng-platform-sam: noted. adding to postmortem: code refs, config diffs, timeline.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (customer-impact reduced). Monitoring for 1h.

oncall-omar: final note: if anyone on call sees a re-escalation, ping #eng-oncall directly. Thanks all.

customer-success-maya: will update Catalyst after the briefing.

incident-bot: closed active notifications at 09:16 UTC.
